events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect capture commit and check origin ancestry
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git show --stat 512c734 | head -40; git fetch -q origin main 2>&1 | tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor 512c734 origin/main && echo ANCESTOR; ls app/scripts | grep -iE 'guide|anonym'

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check 11 WebP files and their guide references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; for p in s1-overview/03 s2-tantra-pro-funnel/16 s4-challenge/08 s4-challenge/11 s4-challenge/16 s4-rsp/14 s5-challenge-stages/01 s5-rsp-stages/01 s5-rsp-stages/02 s5-webinar-stages/01 s6-sms/03; do f=public/guides/$p.webp; printf "%s %s %s refs=%s\n" $p "$(file -b $f | cut -c1-40)" "$(sips -g pixelWidth -g pixelHeight $f 2>/dev/null | awk '/pixel/{printf $2"x"}')" "$(grep -rl "/guides/$p.webp" src/content/guides | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"; done; git diff 512c734 HEAD --stat -- public/guides src/content/guides | tail -3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check s4 guide image references
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; grep -n "08.webp\|11.webp\|16.webp\|s4-challenge/\|img(" src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-challenge.ts | head -20; grep -n "14.webp\|image\|shot" src/content/guides/s4-conversion/s4-rsp.ts | head -10; git diff 512c734 HEAD -- src/content/guides/s4-conversion | head -40

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run probe-guides and compare capture-needed before/after commit
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; timeout 500 node scripts/probe-guides.mjs "http://localhost:4322/debug/guides?v=t135v" 2>&1 | tail -6; git show 512c734^:app/scripts/check-guides.mjs >/dev/null 2>&1; git stash list | head -0; git worktree add -q /tmp/t135pre 512c734^ 2>&1|tail -1; (cd /tmp/t135pre/app && node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | grep capture-needed); (cd /tmp/t135pre/app/.. && git -C /tmp/t135pre checkout -q 512c734 && cd app && node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | grep capture-needed); git worktree remove --force /tmp/t135pre

events.name: Bash
events.head: Compare capture-needed count before and after commit
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git worktree list | grep t135pre; for c in 512c734^ 512c734; do rm -rf /tmp/t135c; mkdir /tmp/t135c; git archive $c app/scripts/check-guides.mjs app/src/content/guides app/public/guides | tar -x -C /tmp/t135c; (cd /tmp/t135c/app && node scripts/check-guides.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E "capture-needed|FAIL" | head -6); done; rm -rf /tmp/t135c
